lab_hum: a basement laboratory ambience: soft electrical hum, gentle bubbling beakers, an old pipe ticking, loopable, no voices, no music
sheet: a large cloth sheet yanked off a big machine, a quick fabric whoosh and flap
scan: a futuristic hologram scanner sweeping: soft digital chirps, data ticking and rolling numbers, sci-fi interface beeps, clean
lever: a big heavy metal lever pulled down hard, a mechanical clunk
charge: a huge sci-fi cannon powering up: a rising electrical whine getting higher and louder, lights buzzing, building tension, no explosion
pew: a tiny weak toy laser pointer sound, one small cute pew, very quiet and pathetic
meow: one curious house cat meowing once, close, natural
crash: glass beakers knocked off a lab bench by a cat, glass clinking and shattering, a few rolling
meows: a crowd of many house cats meowing at once outside a window, a chorus of meows, natural
chaos: many cats running and scrambling around a room: paws skittering, things knocked over, meows, pigeons flapping away, cartoon chaos
flutter: a few pigeons flapping their wings and flying away in a hurry
purr: several cats purring loudly and contentedly together, close, loopable
scratch: cat claws scratching across a chalkboard in one quick circle, a scrape, not too harsh
whoosh: a quick soft cartoon whoosh swish
thump: a cat landing softly on a wooden table, a light thump
